title: Manual ones are better.
text:
Manual ones are better.. This is great to use if you have the time and patience. Honestly, though, I've had a harder time using this than the manual openers. How? I can never get the position flush with the bottle, and it always scrapes to the side. The machine always sounds like it's going to run out of the juice, thought it doesn't for a while.

It's sleek and adds to the kitchen, but the manual one, though less "fancy" is better.
